mcq_drop.why: circular A/R (A and R say the same thing), oddly worded
oddly worded ('the indicated forecast'); unverifiable news trivia

patterns: APPSC asks pressure-belt facts in statement form: doldrums are calm (not strong winds), NH trades are north-easterly, horse latitudes 30-35 deg, ITCZ near the equator.
Coriolis deflection (right in NH) and pressure gradient setting wind speed are recurring single-fact items.
Other PSCs heavily test local wind-region matching (Foehn-Alps, Chinook raises winter temperature, Harmattan, Sirocco blood rain, Bora not Siberia) and Roaring Forties = SH westerlies.
Monsoon basics: 'Mausim' Arabic, seasonal reversal from differential heating; A/R items on winter anticyclones.
App adds jet-stream detail (STJ/TEJ/Somali jet), polar vortex and 2026 AP monsoon/cyclone current data beyond PYQ depth; otherwise aligned.
